title: dexterm-limits/1
description: dexterm real-mode limits: $DEXTERM_HOME/autotrade/real/limits.json. A number in global replaces the placeholder default (null turns it off); every other scope can only tighten (the stricter number wins). Only `dexterm autotrade limits` writes it; raising needs a typed confirmation on a real terminal.

perTradeSol.description: the most SOL one buy signal may spend (a bigger buy is clamped down to it) (SOL; a cap: smaller is stricter)

perTradePct.description: the most one buy may spend as a percent of the book (bookSol, else the strategy book); with perTradeSol set too, the smaller wins (% of book; a cap: smaller is stricter)

dailySol.description: SOL all buy signals may spend per local day (a buy over it is refused) (SOL/day; a cap: smaller is stricter)

buysPerDay.description: buy signals per local day (0 = no buys) (buys/day; a cap: smaller is stricter)

maxOpenPositions.description: real positions open at once, across every strategy and account on this home (open; a cap: smaller is stricter)

maxExposurePct.description: the cost of every open real position together, as a percent of the book (a buy is clamped to what is left) (% of book; a cap: smaller is stricter)

minPositionSol.description: a buy smaller than this after every clamp is refused (no dust orders) (SOL; a floor: larger is stricter)

maxPositionSol.description: the most SOL one position may cost, adds included (a buy is clamped to what is left) (SOL; a cap: smaller is stricter)

perCoinSolPerDay.description: SOL spent on one coin per local day, re-entries included (a buy over it is refused) (SOL/day; a cap: smaller is stricter)

perCoinBuysPerDay.description: buy signals on one coin per local day (buys/day; a cap: smaller is stricter)

bookSol.description: what the percent limits are a percent of: the size of YOUR account (unset = the strategy's own book) (SOL; a cap: smaller is stricter)

dailyLossSol.description: when the day's realized loss reaches this, no new buy goes out until the next local day (exits still do) (SOL/day; a cap: smaller is stricter)

maxDrawdownSol.description: the drawdown breaker: realized PnL this far below its peak trips it; no new buy until you reset it (typed) (SOL; a cap: smaller is stricter)

lossStreak.description: this many losing closes in a row pause new buys for lossStreakPauseMin (losses; a cap: smaller is stricter)

lossStreakPauseMin.description: how long the loss-streak pause lasts (min; a floor: larger is stricter)

maxHoldMinutes.description: a real position held this long gets its exit signal (the stricter of this and the exit profile's own cap) (min; a cap: smaller is stricter)

minLiquidityUsd.description: no buy on a coin with less pool liquidity (unknown liquidity is refused while this is set) (USD; a floor: larger is stricter)

minMcapUsd.description: no buy on a coin below this market cap (unknown is refused while this is set) (USD; a floor: larger is stricter)

maxSlippageBps.description: the slippage tolerance a signal states (the stricter of this and the strategy's) (bps; a cap: smaller is stricter)

maxPriceImpactPct.description: the price impact a buy may have on the pool (constant-product estimate): a buy is clamped to it; the signal states it (%; a cap: smaller is stricter)

signalTtlSec.description: how long an executor may act on a signal (the stricter of this and the channel setting) (s; a cap: smaller is stricter)

maxBuysPerMinute.description: the signal rate limit: buy signals in any 60 s (buys/min; a cap: smaller is stricter)

maxSellsPerMinute.description: OPTIONAL: sells are never capped unless you set this; a sell over it waits for the next tick (sells/min; a cap: smaller is stricter)

minForwardTrades.description: the evidence floor for real: arming needs a COMPLETED forward test of these exact rules with at least this many closed paper trades, and a backtest on record (below it only a typed override on your own terminal arms, journaled) (trades; a floor: larger is stricter)

executorSilenceMin.description: no heartbeat, receipt or ack from your executor for this long pauses new buy signals (exits still go out) (min; a cap: smaller is stricter)
